title: Ligue 1 Player of the Year 2010/11 to 2020/21
brief: Name the UNFP Ligue 1 Player of the Year for each season from 2010/11 to 2020/21 (no award in 2019/20).
period: Seasons 2010/11 to 2020/21, with no award in 2019/20 (season cut short by COVID-19)

notes.Lisandro Lopez: Lisandro Lopez won it in 2009/10, the season before this board starts.
notes.Kylian Mbappe: Mbappe won it five times in all; the later three (2021/22 to 2023/24) are after these years.
notes.Thiago Silva: Thiago Silva never won the award.

checks: English Wikipedia list matched against French Wikipedia's Trophees UNFP list: all agree, and both say 2019/20 was not awarded. Transfermarkt honours pages also list the award for Hazard (2), Ibrahimovic (3), Cavani, Neymar and Mbappe; Lacazette's 2014/15 award is missing from Transfermarkt but in both Wikipedias (English cites ligue1.com). Ten seasons with an award are used because 2019/20 has none. Ibrahimovic fills three slots, under the limit. Any window reaching 2021/22 or later gives Mbappe four or more slots, so no later window works.
